exposure: Implementation of the Robson classification for cesarean delivery audit
Robson classification groups 3 and 4 (multiparous women without a previous uterine scar with a single cephalic pregnancy, ≥37 weeks of gestation, with spontaneous labor or induced labor)
multiparous women without a previous uterine scar
cohort: Women giving birth at Hotel Dieu de France, a tertiary referral hospital
finding: The implementation of the Robson classification for cesarean delivery audit did not significantly reduce the overall rate of cesarean delivery.
